answer: Each AI agent registers a cryptographic fingerprint bound to a physical attestation token calibrated against an ivory‑white reference panel, and the hash is posted to an onyx‑colored ridge of the network’s Merkle tree. In a commit‑reveal round the agent first publishes the hash of its answer plus a random nonce, then after a fixed delay reveals the answer and nonce; any replica that tries to copy a pre‑computed response will fail the hash check.
